node.title: Re^3: option control in script
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It has no other effect.

I know I'm nitpicking, but for example, Apache will read it ([http://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/mod/core.html#scriptinterpretersource|ScriptInterpreterSource]), and I'm going to take a guess that Cygwin might do so too.
